title: Garbage collection pass
fix_rationale: The trace shows garbage collection took significant frame time. This is commonly caused by high UObject allocation churn, large unpooled actor creation/destruction, or high total object counts.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms (normally {baseline_ms} ms), explaining {share}% of the excess frame time{periodic_clause}.

fixes.text: Pool and reuse transient actors and components instead of frequently creating and destroying them.
Audit total UObject counts using 'obj list' to identify potential reference accumulation or leaks.
Distribute bulk object destruction across multiple frames rather than destroying large sets simultaneously.

verify: Re-capture a trace under identical conditions and verify that garbage collection duration decreases.
caveats: Editor sessions keep extra editor objects alive; GC duration is typically higher in editor sessions than in packaged builds.
